description: This file defines the LeavePolicyAssignment class and related functions for managing leave policy assignments, leave allocations, and employee leave data within an HR management system, specifically in the ERPNext framework.

classes.name: LeavePolicyAssignment
classes.description: A class representing the assignment of leave policies to employees, including validation, leave allocation, and date setting functionalities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the leave policy assignment, checking for overlaps.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon submission of a leave policy assignment.

methods.name: set_dates
methods.description: Sets effective from and to dates based on assignment basis.

methods.name: validate_policy_assignment_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping leave policy assignments for the same employee.

methods.name: grant_leave_alloc_for_employee
methods.description: Allocates leave for an employee based on the policy.

methods.name: create_leave_allocation
methods.description: Creates a leave allocation record for the employee.

methods.name: get_new_leaves
methods.description: Calculates new leave days based on various conditions.

methods.name: get_leaves_for_passed_months
methods.description: Calculates leave for months passed since employee joining.
